description: This file defines API endpoints for managing trainers in a gym management system, including creating, listing, updating, deleting trainers, and managing their availability, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: create_trainer_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new trainer, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: update_trainer_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to update trainer details, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: delete_trainer_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a trainer, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: add_availability_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to add availability for a trainer, accessible by admin or staff.

methods.name: list_availability_endpoint
methods.description: Endpoint to list a trainer's availability.
